messages:
maya (Growth): heads-up — running a small PLG experiment next week: webinar + 100 free credits + 3 prompt-template packs. goal: improve 7-day activation for signups from trial and self-serve. who can own the inbound routing/runbook?
alex (Product Marketing): I can take the runbook. will draft routing rules and a short landing snippet for webinar registrants.
jon (DevEx): i can produce the prompt-template pack (chat, summarize, embed-search). need examples of target app personas. @maya, which segments?
sara (Analytics): target segments: new signups (0 events), low-usage trials (<5 API calls), and power-trialers (>100 calls). we'll treat them as separate cohorts for attribution. I'll add tracking params.
maya (Growth): nice. priority= new signups then low-usage. routing: send new signups to self-serve onboarding flow with credits, low-usage get an automated nudge + templates, power-trialers get an SDR touch.
rita (Customer Ops): for SDR routing — what qualifies as "power-trialers" and what's the handoff payload? we need email, org, token usage, top prompt examples.
sara (Analytics): power-trialers = >100 tokens/day OR >3 distinct endpoints called in last 72h. handoff payload: email, org, total_tokens_7d, top_intent_label. i'll add fields to the webhook.
alex (Product Marketing): webinar landing and follow-up copy draft in the doc: https://docs.company/webinar-prompt-packs — include clear CTA for 'Claim 100 credits' and checkbox to opt into outreach.
jon (DevEx): prompt-template pack will be under /templates/webinar-2026. quick preview:
```
// Chat starter
System: You are a helpful assistant tuned for product Q&A.
User: Summarize this user request into a single sentence and propose a follow-up question.
```
jon (DevEx): also adding two variants: 'developer-first' language and 'pm-friendly' language for A/B.
maya (Growth): ok test matrix: channel: webinar -> CTA -> 100 credits; A/B copy: dev-first vs pm; routing: auto-self-serve vs SDR. primary metric = activated within 7 days (first meaningful API call). secondary = demo requests.
sara (Analytics): setting up experiment ids: webinar_2026_v1 / v2 and routing flags: route_selfserve, route_sdr. i'll add attribution on signup and on claim-credit click.
rita (Customer Ops): for credit fulfillment — what's the flow? is it instant via promo code or manual?
alex (Product Marketing): instant promo code generated by backend. jon, can you add the endpoint so claim-credit -> promo code created, apply to account?
jon (DevEx): yes — will add /internal/promos/create with payload {user_id, source:webinar_2026, variant}. sample rule:
```
if (claim && cohort == 'new_signup') route = 'selfserve_onboard';
else if (claim && cohort == 'low_usage') send = 'nudge_sequence_v3';
else route = 'sdr_handoff';
```
alex (Product Marketing): perfect. i'll own the email templates + post-webinar drip.
maya (Growth): timeline: draft runbook by Tue, landing + promo endpoint by Thu, webinar Thurs week after. sprint tags: #plg-webinar-2026.
sara (Analytics): i'll prepare dashboards: activation funnel, promo redemption rate, sample prompts used. will include segmentation by variant.
rita (Customer Ops): i'll prepare SDR playbook for handoffs and a short checklist for data privacy (KMS/handoff note).
campaign-bot: Reminder set: webinar_2026 - runbook review meeting on Tue 10:00 AM.
maya (Growth): thanks all — small, measurable, move-fast test. we'll reconvene Tue to finalize. :rocket:
